summary: Insteel Industries Inc. filed an 8-K announcing the closure of its Upper Sandusky, Ohio facility, consolidating welded wire manufacturing to remaining plants. Up to 65 positions will be eliminated; operations cease by end of October 2026. The company expects a $4.6 million restructuring charge, including $2.5 million equipment relocation, $0.4 million employee separation, $1.0 million asset impairment, and $0.7 million other costs. Cash expenditures begin in Q1 FY2027. This is a cost reduction/restructuring event, not a strategic review. Watch for execution timing and potential supply disruptions.
